project_name: Overall Beauty & Wellness - Editorial Noir Readability & Usability Enhancement
target_audience: Clients aged 30-65, non-technical, seeking luxury med-spa treatments in Farmingdale, NY
brand_identity: Editorial Noir (Near-black #0A0A0A background, Cream #F9F6F0 text/accents, Gold #D4AF37 accents, Cormorant Garamond display serif italic + Manrope clean sans-serif body)
core_objective: Transform readability, legibility, and usability across all screens and user roles without losing the signature luxury Editorial Noir aesthetic.

contrast_and_opacity_rules.anti_pattern_fix: Eliminate text-white/30, text-white/40, text-white/50, and text-white/60 across all body, paragraph, label, and interactive elements.

minimum_contrast_standards.primary_text: #F9F6F0 (Cream) or #FFFFFF (Pure White) - 100% opacity for main headings and essential body text
minimum_contrast_standards.secondary_text: text-white/85 or #D4D4D4 - WCAG AA compliant on #0A0A0A dark background
minimum_contrast_standards.muted_caption_text: text-white/75 or #A3A3A3 - minimum allowed opacity for secondary metadata/footnotes
minimum_contrast_standards.borders_and_dividers: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.35) or rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20) - clear structural definition without harshness

font_families.display_heading: Cormorant Garamond, Georgia, serif (italic or regular display)

h1_hero.usage: Main hero headline and primary section titles

h2_section.usage: Major page sections, manifesto titles, tab section headers

h3_card_heading.usage: Service titles, modal titles, account section headers

body_primary.usage: Main copy, treatment descriptions, FAQ answers, legal prose

body_secondary.usage: Subtitles, input labels, table secondary values, list metadata

eyebrow_label.tailwind: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-gold
eyebrow_label.usage: Section eyebrows ONLY. Disallowed for buttons, nav links, and body content.

measure_and_line_length.max_width_rule: Limit body prose width to max-w-2xl or 65-75 characters per line (max-w-prose) for effortless reading
measure_and_line_length.text_align_rule: Left-align all paragraphs, form inputs, service descriptions, and legal content. Avoid full center-alignment for long paragraphs.

label_class_refactoring_rules.allowed_usage: Decorative section category eyebrows (e.g., 'CHAPTER 01', 'OUR PHILOSOPHY', 'FARMINGDALE, NY')
label_class_refactoring_rules.forbidden_usage: DO NOT use .label on navigation links, action buttons, table data cells, form field inputs, or service prices.

replacement_classes.nav_links: font-sans text-sm font-medium tracking-wide text-cream/90 hover:text-gold transition-colors duration-200 py-2 px-3 min-h-[44px] flex items-center
replacement_classes.action_buttons: font-sans text-sm sm:text-base font-semibold tracking-wider text-ink bg-gold hover:bg-gold-soft py-3.5 px-6 rounded transition-all duration-200 shadow-md min-h-[48px]
replacement_classes.table_headers: font-sans text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gold/90 border-b border-gold/20 pb-3

touch_and_accessibility.min_tap_target: Minimum 44px x 44px on desktop, 48px x 48px on mobile for all buttons, links, calendar dates, and tab triggers

form_fields.font_size: text-base (prevents iOS auto-zoom on input focus)
form_fields.border_style: border border-white/20 bg-charcoal/60 rounded focus:border-gold focus:ring-1 focus:ring-gold focus:outline-none text-cream placeholder:text-white/50

touch_and_accessibility.focus_states: focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-gold focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-ink rounded-sm
touch_and_accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) by applying motion-reduce:transform-none motion-reduce:transition-none

service_menu_enhancements.layout_structure: Replace cramped single-line text with scannable card rows or spacious 2-column grids

item_hierarchy.title: font-serif text-xl sm:text-2xl text-cream font-medium
item_hierarchy.aka_badge: inline-block text-xs font-sans text-gold/90 bg-gold/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-gold/30 ml-2.5
item_hierarchy.description: font-sans text-sm sm:text-base text-white/85 mt-2 leading-relaxed max-w-xl
item_hierarchy.price_tag: font-sans text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold text-gold text-right min-w-[100px]
item_hierarchy.note: font-sans text-xs text-white/75 italic mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1
item_hierarchy.book_button: mt-3 sm:mt-0 font-sans text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-ink bg-gold hover:bg-gold-soft px-4 py-2.5 rounded transition-all

table_design.header_style: bg-charcoal/90 text-gold text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider p-4 border-b border-gold/30 text-left
table_design.row_style: border-b border-white/10 hover:bg-white/[0.03] transition-colors p-4 text-cream text-sm font-sans min-h-[56px]
table_design.status_badges: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide

studio_admin_panel_enhancements.tab_navigation: Wrap tabs in scannable, horizontally scrollable tabs container with clear active state underline and gold accent text

usability_additions.mobile_sticky_action_bar: Fixed bottom bar on mobile viewports featuring direct 'BOOK CONSULTATION' CTA (min 48px height) and phone/directions quick links
usability_additions.skip_link: Skip to main content
usability_additions.sticky_navigation: Header with backdrop-blur-md bg-ink/90 border-b border-gold/20 z-50 transition-all duration-300

hero_and_treatment_images.alt: Esthetician performing facial on client in luxury treatment room
Serene and modern spa treatment room with precision equipment

general_ui_ux_testing_guidelines.data_testid_rule: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and critical text nodes MUST include explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='nav-book-now-button', data-testid='service-item-price').
general_ui_ux_testing_guidelines.testing_stability: Ensure data-testid attributes remain static across state changes for reliable end-to-end testing.
